name: @rsc-quiescent/alpaca-account-kill-switch-service
description: PAPER-ONLY account kill switch: computes drawdown against a persisted high-water mark and daily loss against Alpaca's own last-close equity, and on trip disables --now every existing Alpaca loop timer and records the trip. Wired as ExecStartPre= of each loop's service and run standalone on its own 30-minute market-hours timer.
